verdict.rationale: Meltano is a self-hosted and managed ELT platform, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of API tokens, credential scoping, or least-privilege access controls. The probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the CLI and config docs cover only plugin settings, not issuing credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
